title: Known violations -- what a HOST acknowledges is already in its tree, and who tracks it
description: The whole-tree audit (`audit`, gate FF-TREE-AUDIT) runs every calibrated edit gate in force over the full text of every tracked file. A violation the host already knows of is ACKNOWLEDGED here, by declaration -- never by silencing or narrowing the gate, which keeps holding every new edit. One row covers every line one gate finds in one path. An acknowledgement whose `until` (the last day it holds) has passed acknowledges nothing, so its findings stand again; one that matches no finding is STALE and is reported for removal (ADR-024 decision 20).

gate.description: The id of the edit gate whose finding this acknowledges.

path.description: The host-relative POSIX path of the tracked file, exactly -- never a pattern, so one row can never acknowledge a file nobody looked at.

tracking.description: Where the repair is tracked: a card, an issue, a register row.

until.description: The last day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) this acknowledgement holds.
